titleEn: List templates with Meta review status and rejection reason
steps: Open Templates in the side menu: every template with its type, language and Meta status (live, in Meta review, rejected, paused, disabled, being deleted)
Open one for its preview, the rejection reason in plain words (Meta's code below it) and what can be done
edgeCases: Own number not connected: 404 no_active_number (a store on the shared number sees the platform templates instead, never an empty list)
Connection to WhatsApp expired or closed: 503 token_unavailable, reconnect the number on the Numbers screen
A template made in WhatsApp Manager shows after Sync with Meta, with its raw name when it has no title
Staff see the list and detail read-only
